Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · list cell editing redone after Attio: the row height stays when editing, form controls are no longer stuffed into cells, and each field type uses one of three patterns (type in place, open a popover, act directly); maintainer: 「我双击编辑的时候，点看右侧的界面很丑」 … 「立卡」; topic #35547 → p2 as set by the coordinator · size L (per field type; the claimant may split by pattern).

Area: b1-I7

File surface: `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/` lookup / master-detail / user, currency, percent, number, rating, rich-text preview, and the in-cell look of the seven typed-input widgets (text, number, currency, percent, email, phone, url); `ui/packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx`; `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (in-cell host keys, read-only cell types); `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` (overlay padding and width only); the i18n packs (a few new hint keys); the QA checklist and Task Desk text for #35794; tests; a changeset.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:thread`, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (expected; widening: widgets read the existing `inCell` host key, and a few i18n keys are added). The seat runs the declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT` on the measured declarations.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: the card thread's gap table on main `c00be39b` (read-only code check; browser readings marked "to measure"). #36023 (filed 2026-11-21 07:49Z, given to this seat 07:59:12Z) asks for more than #35688's remaining plan, so the card is cut into S3, S4 and a third piece.
Basis: card #35688 (epic #35683); card #36023 (epic #35547); the maintainer's ruling 7057128455 (「下周」 = today + 7 days) stands.
Scope, the seat's reading:
1. S3 (this PR): #35688's remaining per-type rows (lookup, master-detail and user as a searchable list that commits on pick, with recent and clear, and the local recents key prefixed by the user id; currency as the currency code plus the raw number right-aligned; percent without the slider; rating set in place; formula, rollup, autonumber and attachment as read-only cells; #35794), plus from #36023 the flat in-cell input for the seven typed-input kinds (height = row height, no own border, radius or fill, numbers right-aligned, long content grows to the right) and the rating number keys 1 to 5.
2. Rich text: this PR shows the preview and a hint to edit on the record page, as #35688 says. The panel editor #36023 asks for is not refused; it stays on #36023 for a later slice.
3. Where #35688 and #36023 differ, the newer card #36023 is taken: the pop-up panel opens under the cell and leaves the cell value as it is; multi-select and tags save on Esc; Enter saves and stays on the cell. That last one reverses the merged #35687 behaviour (save and move down), so the PR that does it names the change in its body, does it in its own commit and updates the tests that assert the move.
4. S4 (new session, `Part of #36023`): panel under the cell for S1/S2's pop-up kinds, Esc saves for multi-select and tags, Enter stays, Backspace clears and saves (a required field refuses with a hint), validation keeps the input and shows the reason, the selection frame on frozen columns and the leftover orange frame after Esc.
5. The form's line-item table (`GridField`) is a separate component that S1 and S2 did not touch; the seat files it as its own card under #35547. The related-list tab follows #35892 and gets one reading after it lands.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #36015 (thread building) edits `data-table.tsx` clicks and the email/phone renderers next to this slice; whoever lands second merges main. `overlap-check.mjs` runs before each push. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.

Basis: card #36023 (epic #35547).
Scope, the seat's reading (way A, recommended; the choice between A and select-then-edit B goes to the maintainer after a fable review, and this claim is amended if B is picked):
1. Keep direct typing. Select, date, datetime and time open the S2 in-cell panels under the cell on click, Enter or typing, and commit on pick; long text floats right while focused; Esc discards the cell's current change; the "date does not exist" line becomes a popover under the cell instead of a second line that grows the row.
2. Enter keeps its current line-item rule (move down; at the last row add a row), unless the maintainer rules otherwise.
3. Lookup takes S3's `LookupField` in-cell face once S3 merges; if S5 is ready first, lookup stays as it is and follows.
4. Not in this slice: new column types (check, rating, multi-select, tags, people, colour) need the spec column-type enum, so they go to their own card; people and multi-select folded into plain text boxes get a bug card if the browser reading confirms it.

Premise: the card thread's read on main `c00be39b` (`/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/36023/S4/premise.md`, code only). The data table cannot tell a select from a text column, so the host says which cells open a panel below, through the per-cell selection facts `ObjectGrid.describeCell` already supplies.
Basis: card #36023 (epic #35547); a fable review of the open questions (09:30Z) and the maintainer's answers on the two decision cards in the seat thread.
Scope, the seat's reading:
1. Picker kinds (select, status, multi-select, tags, date, datetime, time, colour, and lookup/people from S3) open their panel under the cell and leave the cell value as drawn; the typeable date box moves into the panel top. Long text and address keep their in-place editor that does not jump.
2. Backspace or Delete on a selected cell clears and saves; a required field does not clear and shows a hint (`clearRefusal`).
3. A failing validation keeps the input and the editor open and shows the reason under the cell: the browser's own bad-input reading and an optional host `validate` (declared min/max, length, format). Esc discards.
4. The selection frame is not drawn over frozen columns; no orange frame is left after Esc.
5. Waiting the maintainer's decision cards, built last and only as ruled: Enter = save and stay (reverses merged #35687; own commit, named in the body, #35687's open Safari check text reworded) and Esc saving for multi-select and tags. Until ruled, Esc = discard for every kind and Enter is unchanged.
Resume-from: none

1. **Multi-line text and address stay in place** (option A, 2026-11-21T13:12Z). Their editor keeps opening over the cell, with the full text and no jump in position or size. Item 2's "panel under the cell" applies to the picker kinds only, as S4 #36054 built it. Leftover 3 in the seat note 7062367434 is closed by this ruling.
2. **The eager `ui-components` budget is raised by about 8 KB, with headroom** (option B, 2026-11-21T13:12Z), so S5 #36039 (the form's line-item grid cells, +2,679 B gzip measured on one main) can land. The raise goes in its own budget-only PR, not on #36039. As `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` "Raising it" requires, that PR moves the ceiling and the baseline together, publishes the rows from two builds on one tree, says what the bytes buy, and cites this ruling as the maintainer's authorisation. Still owed on this card: leftover 1 (rich text panel), leftover 2 (related-list tab, waits on #35892), and leftover 4 (the #35687 rewording at S4's landing).

Enter in the panel is a new line; on a select-first grid Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves and keeps the cell selected, Esc discards, and a click outside saves. Backspace or Delete on the selected cell of a select-first grid clears it as for any other editable cell. On a grid without the select-first cell model (an `ObjectGrid` or `object-grid` mounted without `cellSelection`), one click opens the text box over the cell, not in a panel under it: Enter is a new line, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter does nothing, Esc discards, and a click outside keeps the text as a pending change for the grid's save buttons. Before, these cells opened no editor and said "This field can't be edited in a list". The related tab on the record page draws the same grid and behaves the same way.
